Omega: Effective potential (minus the potential energy per unit mass in the rotating frame)
P: Orbital period of the two masses, the unit of time
P_lib: Period of small librations about L4 or L5
a: Separation of the two masses, the unit of length
e: Euler's number, 2.71828… (in Tisserand's parameter, the comet's eccentricity)
n: Angular speed of the rotating frame, 2π/P
r: Distance from the axis of rotation
r_H: Hill radius of the smaller mass
x: Position along the line of the two masses
y: Position across the line of the two masses
